column3: settled in the pack - 7th at halfway - into 4th inside the final 3f and shaken up - pressed again with 2f to run - hit the front a furlong out - pulled clear without being extended

handy early - 4th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - improved into the front with 2f to run - driven when pressed inside the final 2f - passed a furlong out but held on for second unable to peg back the winner
settled towards the back - 8th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and improved inside the final 2f before running on in the last furlong
restrained at the back - shaken up and gaining ground though short of room with 3f to run - driven and improving again from 2f out then battled on late
sat behind the pacesetter - 2nd at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and faded with 2f to run and never a threat
settled towards the back - improving from 2f out under pressure - drifted left with 1f to run - stuck on without a change of gear and was never a threat
set the pace - clear by two lengths at halfway - shaken up inside the final 3f - driven and overtaken with 2f to run - faded rapidly with 1f to run and never got competitive
travelled in the pack out wide - 5th at halfway - shaken up with 4f to run - driven but found nothing more inside the final 3f - never got competitive
sluggish leaving the stalls - settled at the back of the pack - 9th at halfway - shaken up with 4f to run - lost touch from 3f out - not knocked about near the finish and well beaten in the end
settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - shaken up and slipped towards the back with 3f to run before soon beaten a long way
settled in the pack - 3rd at halfway - shaken up with 4f to run - dropped away rapidly from 3f out and beaten a long way

settled in the pack travelling wide - slipped to 12th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and improving again from 2f out - took on the front pair 150 yards out - ran on strongly to hit the front inside the final 50 yards

handy early travelling keenly - slipped to 7th at halfway - made ground when shaken up inside the final 3f - drifted left and short of room inside the final 2f - went in front by a whisker inside the final 100 yards - overtaken near the finish

moved into a handy spot after 1f - travelled wide - 3rd at halfway - driven into the front with 2f to run - soon came under pressure - overtaken inside the final 150 yards and held on without finding more

settled towards the back of the pack - improved into 6th at halfway - made further ground when shaken up with 2f to run - driven and shared the front with 1f to run - overtaken inside the final 100 yards and found nothing more in the closing strides
sluggish leaving the stalls - travelled keenly in the pack - 8th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven to take on the front pair with 1f to run - soon found nothing more near the finish
settled at the back of the pack - 9th at halfway - shaken up with 2f to run - made ground when driven 2f out - drifted left from 1f out and faded inside the final 100 yards
settled towards the back - shaken up with 2f to run - driven and made a little ground inside the final 2f - ran on in the last furlong without ever getting closer
held up towards the back - shaken up with 3f to run - driven with 2f to run - stuck on without a change of gear and was not a factor
settled towards the back - 10th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - hampered a little with 2f to run - driven with 1f to run and stuck on without a change of gear
handy early - slipped into the pack after 1f - improved to 4th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and seriously hampered with 2f to run then unable to fight back
set the pace - driven inside the final 3f - overtaken with 2f to run and soon found nothing more before fading
settled in the pack travelling wide - slipped to 11th at halfway - shaken up with 4f to run - lost touch from 2f out - never a threat
settled towards the back - driven with 3f to run - played no part in the finish
sluggish start - moved up to press the pacesetter after 1f - 2nd at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven when seriously hampered with 2f to run and soon allowed to coast
sat behind the pacesetter - 5th at halfway - shaken up and lost touch from 3f out without ever threatening
In front from the outset and asked for full effort a furlong out - drew off in the final 110 yards
Settled in third early - up into second two furlongs out and driven after the leader approaching the final furlong - held no threat to the winner in the final 110 yards
Second early - under pressure and surrendered that spot two furlongs out before fading - not knocked about in the final 110 yards
settled in behind the pace-setter early - asked to go 2f out then hit the front over 1f out - ran on strongly in the final furlong to win
settled behind the pace early - pushed along over 2f out and made ground on the winner 1f out - kept on through the final furlong
racing handy and tracking the front-runner early - pushed along 3f out - went to the front over 2f out - overtaken over 1f out - held the same gear through the final furlong
settled at the back of the field early - asked for effort 3f out but faded from there - showed no more than one gear from over 1f out
settled towards the back of the field early - improved and was pushed along 3f out - faded over 1f out
showed early speed to get to the front - was pressed for effort and lost the advantage over 2f out - dropped away in a hurry and was allowed an easy time over 1f out
handy early - 6th at halfway - short of room from 3f out - shaken up to take on the pace with 1f to run - driven into the front inside the final 200 yards and ran on strongly near the finish
set the pace - overtaken after 1f - 7th at halfway - shaken up but short of room from 2f out - moved right and driven with 1f to run - ran on near the finish to grab second on the line

raced up behind the pacesetter - 4th at halfway - shaken up and improved into the front inside the final 2f - driven with 1f to run - overtaken with 1f to run - stuck on without a change of gear near the finish and was pipped for second on the line
settled in the pack travelling keenly and wide - 5th at halfway - driven and involved in the pace battle with 2f to run - faded in the final furlong
settled in the pack - 8th at halfway - shaken up and steadily made ground from 3f out - ran on in the final furlong without ever getting closer

settled towards the back travelling keenly - 10th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - made a little ground inside the final 2f - moved right and driven with 1f to run - found nothing more in the final furlong
settled towards the back travelling wide - shaken up with 3f to run - driven inside the final 2f - found nothing more and was not a factor all the way

handy early - moved into the front after 1f - drawn level at halfway - shaken up inside the final 3f - driven with 2f to run - drifted left and overtaken with 1f to run before fading in the final furlong
settled in the pack travelling keenly - made ground to share the front at halfway - overtaken and shaken up with 3f to run - faded rapidly from inside the final 2f
restrained towards the back - shaken up with 3f to run - made a little ground up the run-in but stayed behind throughout
sluggish leaving the stalls - settled in the pack - slipped to 9th at halfway - shaken up and driven inside the final 3f - lost touch from 2f out without ever threatening
settled in the pack travelling wide - 3rd at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - faded rapidly from 2f out without ever threatening
settled at the back of the pack and still 11th at halfway - driven from 3f out but faded rapidly with 2f to run - beaten a long way at the back
Third early - driven two furlongs out - up to second entering the final furlong before hitting the front in the final 110 yards - stayed on
In front from the outset - roused two furlongs out and battled on the final furlong - overtaken in the final 110 yards - denied by the winner
Second early - driven two furlongs out and dropped that position approaching the final furlong - faded in the final 110 yards
Fourth early and drifted left under pressure two furlongs out - made no further impact from the final furlong
settled behind the pace early - pushed along 3f out and improved to the front over 1f out - stayed on powerfully in the final furlong to win
tracked the front-runners early - went to the front over 3f out and was pushed along 2f out - overtaken over 1f out - found nothing more inside the final furlong
settled towards the back early - pushed along over 3f out - kept on at one gear from 2f out
raced at the back of the field early - pushed along over 3f out - held the same gear from over 1f out
settled at the back early - made ground and was pushed along over 2f out - drifted left and showed only one gear from over 1f out
set the pace until overtaken and pushed along over 3f out - faded 2f out
settled behind the pace early - pushed along 3f out - faded over 1f out
settled in the pack - 4th at halfway - made effortless ground with 3f to run - shaken up with 2f to run - driven into the front with 1f to run and ran on powerfully in the final furlong

sluggish leaving the stalls - settled towards the back - 9th at halfway - shaken up and moved right with 2f to run - driven and made ground inside the final 2f - moved into second and drifted left with 1f to run then held on without reeling in the winner

sat behind the pacesetter - 2nd at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - made ground for a short spell in front with 2f to run - driven and overtaken inside the final 2f then found nothing more inside the final 200 yards
handy early - 3rd at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and moved right inside the final 2f then stuck on without a change of gear in the final furlong
settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - made effortless ground with 2f to run - shaken up inside the final 2f then driven and faded with 1f to run
settled at the back of the pack - 7th and shaken up at halfway - moved right with 2f to run - hampered and driven with 2f to run - faded with 1f to run and never threatened
settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and faded with 2f to run and never threatened
sluggish start - settled towards the back - 8th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven but made no inroads with 2f to run and was not a factor
settled towards the back travelling wide - slipped to the tail of the field at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - made no inroads
set the pace - clear by two lengths and shaken up at halfway - driven and overtaken inside the final 3f before fading rapidly with 2f to run
Handy early - hit the front two furlongs out - roused over a furlong out and challenged in the final furlong - held on close home
Settled handy early and drifted left while improving two furlongs out - driven into second and challenged the winner in the final furlong - narrowly beaten close home
Close up early - hit the front after a furlong before coming under pressure and being overtaken two furlongs out - without finding another gear to the finish
Set the pace early - overtaken soon after but stayed in touch and came under pressure two furlongs out - faded in the final furlong
Settled handy early - driven two furlongs out but never threatened
tracked the front-runners early - was asked to take over in front 2f out - kept finding more from over 1f out and was driven out in the final furlong to win
settled behind the pace early - was pushed along over 2f out - kept on strongly to move into second in the final furlong without getting on terms with the winner
broke quickly to command the early stages - pushed along over 2f out and overtaken 2f out - showed only one gear from over 1f out
eased back early to settle at the back of the field - was pushed along over 2f out - shifted left and showed only one gear from over 1f out
tracked the front-runner early - was pushed along over 2f out and still holding a strong claim 1f out - faded inside the final furlong
moved left after 1f to run in isolation away from the rest - was pushed along over 2f out - held no chance and was allowed an easy time inside the final furlong
handy early - 4th at halfway - shaken up with 2f to run - driven to edge into the front with 1f to run and ran on in the final furlong
set the pace - margin cut to a length by halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven with 2f to run - overtaken with 1f to run then ran on but was narrowly denied near the finish
sat behind the pacesetter - 2nd at halfway - shaken up inside the final 3f - driven and slipped to 3rd inside the final 2f - faded with 1f to run and stuck on without a change of gear
settled towards the back - 7th at halfway - swung wide with 2f to run while driven - kept on late without ever getting closer
settled at the back of the pack - 8th at halfway - shaken up with 2f to run - bumped with 1f to run - made a little ground in the final furlong without ever threatening
settled in the pack travelling keenly - 5th at halfway - driven with 2f to run - faded with 1f to run and made no inroads
settled in the pack - moved into 3rd at halfway - shaken up after being passed with 3f to run - driven with 2f to run then faded
sluggish leaving the stalls - settled towards the back - two lengths adrift near the tail at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - stuck on without a change of gear and was behind throughout
settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - shaken up but faded rapidly with 3f to run and beaten a long way
In touch with the pace early - up to second two furlongs out - driven to hit the front just over a furlong out and stayed on

Settled towards the back early - a long way off the pace two furlongs out - roused and made headway just over a furlong out - kept on well in the final furlong - up into second close home - unable to get to the winner but caught the eye in defeat
Set the pace early - driven and overtaken just over a furlong out - stayed on in the final furlong before dropping to third near the line
In mid-division early - put under pressure just over two furlongs out and soon found nothing
Settled towards the back early - dropped away after a furlong - came under pressure approaching two furlongs out - went by tiring horses a furlong out but never threatened
In mid-division early - driven over two furlongs out before soon fading
Close up early but driven and dropped a position two furlongs out - pulled up a furlong out
made all the running from the start - responded with a turn of speed 2f out - was driven out in the final furlong to win
settled towards the back early - made ground and was pushed along 2f out - kept on strongly in the final furlong but couldn't get to the winner
tracked the front-runners early - was pushed along 2f out - found nothing more inside the final furlong
tracked the winner early - was pushed along 2f out - drifted left from over 1f out and faded inside the final furlong
eased back early to settle at the back of the field - was niggled for effort after 1f and asked again 2f out - showed only the same gear in the final furlong without threatening the front-runners
settled towards the back early - was pushed along 2f out - showed only one gear from over 1f out
settled in the pack and full of running - 3rd at halfway - moved out and driven with 1f to run - improved into the front with 1f to run - ran on powerfully near the finish
set the pace - clear by a length - kicked clear with 3f to run - shaken up with 2f to run - driven when pressed with 1f to run - overtaken with 1f to run and ran on but was denied near the finish

sluggish leaving the stalls - settled towards the back - 4th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven and improved into 3rd inside the final 2f - found nothing more in the final furlong and stuck on without a change of gear
sluggish start - settled towards the back - shaken up with 3f to run - passed by faster rivals with 2f to run - stuck on without a change of gear with 1f to run and was not a factor
handy early - 2nd at halfway - shaken up inside the final 3f - driven inside the final 2f - soon found nothing more and faded rapidly with 1f to run
In command from the break - roused just over a furlong out and drew off in the final furlong
Handy behind the front-runner early - driven in pursuit of the winner over two furlongs out but unable to threaten in the final furlong
Among the rear group early - pressed for a response over two furlongs out and soon toiling
Towards the back early - driven over two furlongs out and soon found nothing
made all the running from the start - was asked for effort to extend the advantage 2f out - went further ahead from over 1f out to win easily

was immature in the early stages and needed urging towards the back of the field - was asked for effort over 2f out - kept on strongly from over 1f out without getting competitive enough to trouble the winner
tracked the winner early - was pushed along 3f out - faded 1f out
was sluggish from the gate but made ground to close on the front-runners after 1f - was pushed along 2f out - faded over 1f out
settled at the back of the field early - found nothing for speed and dropped away over 2f out
in front for almost the whole way - was taken on after 3f but quickly asserted again - driven when pressed with 1f to run - ran on powerfully near the finish
settled in the pack - 5th at halfway - shaken up with 2f to run - driven to close on the leader with 1f to run - found nothing more inside the final 100 yards but held on
settled in the pack - 9th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - made ground with 2f to run - driven with 1f to run - ran on in the final furlong without ever getting closer
sat behind the pacesetter - 4th at halfway - driven with 2f to run - slipped out of third inside the final 150 yards and stuck on without a change of gear
settled towards the back - shaken up with 3f to run - driven inside the final 2f - ran on strongly in the final furlong but was not involved in the finish
handy early - slipped to 8th at halfway - shaken up inside the final 4f - driven inside the final 3f - briefly short of room with 1f to run and made no inroads
restrained towards the back travelling wide and keenly - made quick ground into 7th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - improved again when driven inside the final 2f - faded in the final furlong
sluggish leaving the stalls - settled towards the back - shaken up with 3f to run - moved wide when driven with 2f to run - ran on late without ever threatening
raced up behind the pacesetter - 3rd at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - driven with 2f to run - faded with 1f to run and made no inroads
settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - shaken up though short of room with 2f to run - not knocked about in the final furlong and never threatened
settled in the pack - made ground to share the front after 3f - shaken up with 3f to run then faded rapidly from 2f out
settled at the back of the pack travelling wide - shaken up at halfway - found nothing more and faded with 2f to run - well beaten at the finish
settled at the back of the pack - shaken up at halfway - driven but slipped further back with 3f to run and was beaten a long way
settled in the pack - 10th at halfway - shaken up with 3f to run - faded rapidly and slipped to the back with 2f to run before beaten a long way
Well placed in behind the pace - sent to the front 2f out - driven approaching the final furlong - kept on under pressure to prevail

Started towards the back of the field - made ground 3f out - up to third with 2f to run - driven and in with a shout before the final furlong but couldn't get on terms with the winner to finish second
Settled in the pack early - made noticeable ground with 2f to run - soon driven and kept on without finding more to finish third
In touch with the front runners early - driven approaching 2f out - found nothing more inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Started towards the back of the pack - driven into contention with 3f to run and up to fourth approaching the final furlong - couldn't find more late to finish fifth
Handy early - made headway with 5f to run and up to second 3f out - soon driven and faded to finish sixth
Raced in the pack - driven with 3f to run and faded without much resistance to finish seventh
Settled towards the back of the field and given a squeeze with 7f to run - showed nothing in a well-beaten eighth
Set a modest tempo in front - lost the advantage after 2 furlongs but continued to race close up - driven and lost touch with 4f to run to finish ninth
Raced in touch with the front runners before going on after 2 furlongs and quickening away - lost the advantage with 2f to run and faded to finish tenth
Racing in the pack - driven and lost touch in a hurry with 3f to run to come home last
Third early - up to second three furlongs out - hit the front just over a furlong out - driven away in the final furlong to score easily
Set a strong gallop from the front - driven two furlongs out before being overtaken just over a furlong out - unable to threaten the winner in the final furlong
Over-raced in second - slipped to third three furlongs out before soon finding nothing under pressure
settled towards the back of the pack - improved through the middle from 2f out to go second inside the final furlong - pressed the pacesetter and got up on the line
started towards the back - improved position from 2f out - driven to close in and go ahead inside the final furlong - flat out when overhauled close home
settled in third early - travelled in a handy position - driven along passing the 2f marker and pressed the front pair inside the final furlong - stayed on without finding more close home
went to the front early and dictated an even gallop - driven when passed with a furlong left - faded into fourth towards the finish
tracked the pace in second early - went up to challenge for a short spell 3f out before fading rapidly passing the 1f marker - allowed to finish quietly after appearing not to travel freely
dwelt at the start - settled at the back - hampered passing the 3f marker - driven to gain a little ground 2f out - found no answer passing the 1f marker and soon fell adrift
raced in the pack - drifted right and hampered another runner 3f out - short of pace over 2f out and beaten off from 1f out
tracked the front-runner early - was pushed along over 2f out - kept on strongly to hit the front inside the final furlong and win

was sluggish leaving the stalls - showed eagerness to close on the front-runners 3f out and was travelling strongly over 2f out - went to the front 2f out - was asked for effort over 1f out - overtaken inside the final furlong but battled on to finish second
broke smartly to command the early stages - was pushed along over 2f out and was still right in contention 1f out - found nothing more inside the final furlong
raced towards the back early - was niggled for effort 3f out then slipped further back and was driven hard 2f out - faded rapidly and had no answer over 1f out

Held up towards the back of the field early and still towards the tail of it at the fifth - driven before 3 out - made ground before 2 out to be involved in a four-way fight for fourth - driven again before the last and powered up the home straight to prevail close home

Raced in touch with the pace - disputed the front at the eighth - driven 3 out - edged ahead 2 out - eased down in premature celebration after the second last - kept finding under pressure but was reeled in close home to finish second

Set the pace from the start - came under pressure at the eighth - driven 3 out - lost the advantage by a short margin 2 out - kept on under the drive but couldn't find more up the home straight to finish third
Sat behind the front pack - driven 3 out - kept on without the turn of foot to get on terms and finished fourth
Well placed early - driven and dropped back through the field 3 out - asked for more before 2 out - responded up the run-in without ever threatening the principals to finish fifth
Racing handy in the pack - made ground before 3 out to move into fourth before being driven and unable to improve after 2 out to finish sixth
Held up towards the back of the pack - driven 3 out but made little impression on proceedings to finish seventh
Held up towards the back of the field and still in the pack at the third - faded after 3 out to finish eighth
Racing in the pack early and towards the tail of the field at the fifth - driven at the eighth - hesitant at the fourth last and asked for more - found nothing to finish ninth
Held up towards the back of the field - clipped the third and made an error at the fourth - pulled up after the fifth
Led from the start - driven and challenged inside the final furlong - stayed on to prevail
Settled behind the pace - driven into second and challenged the winner inside the final furlong - ran on but denied by the winner
In a forward position - driven to challenge the winner inside the final furlong - continued at one speed to the line
Settled at the back of the field - urged to quicken and made ground into fourth inside the final furlong - continued well to the line
Settled towards the back - urged along 2f out - found extra late to take fifth close home
Raced close to the pace - driven with a furlong left - faded in the closing stages
Racing in the pack - lost touch with the leading group 2f out - soon dropped away
Up with the pace - driven 2f out - faded in the final furlong
Settled towards the back - driven hard with two furlongs left - always adrift and no threat late on

settled towards the back - short of room passing the 3f marker - made up ground on the pack 2f out - finished strongly from 1f out - hit the front inside the final 110 yards and kept finding more to the line
raced in the pack - made progress passing the 2f marker - went to the front with a furlong left - driven when overtaken inside the final 110 yards but stayed on
contested the front early - travelled in a forward position after 2f - went in front for a short spell passing the 1f marker before being overtaken - no match for the front two towards the finish

raced close up with the pace and up into third before halfway - driven over 2f out - responded but boxed in on several occasions inside the final furlong - once in space stayed on without gaining towards the finish
contested the front early - travelled in a forward position after 2f - driven 3f out - well held for pace with a furlong left before fading inside it
shared the front early then went several lengths up after 2f - driven when overtaken 2f out - faded fast inside the final furlong
sluggish start and settled towards the back early - found wanting for speed from over 2f out - stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong

sluggish start and settled towards the back early - shaped into the tail of the pack after 1f - driven 3f out - soon found wanting for speed and slipped towards the back again over 2f out - soon well adrift
Set the pace from the off - erred at the third and was hesitant at the fifth - driven 2 out and responded in good order - asserted to score with a little in hand

Raced close to the front early - dropped towards the back at the eighth - recovered into third after the eleventh - driven 4 out - kept on without the turn of foot to get on terms with the winner and finished second

Settled towards the back early - sloppy over the sixth - made ground at the eighth to move into second at the following flight - kept going at one gear from 4 out - erred at the last and had nothing more to give to drop from second to third
Racing close to the pace early - dropped away at the ninth and towards the back at the following flight - unable to get competitive again to finish fourth
Raced close to the front early - clipped the third and blundered badly at the eleventh dropping several places - well beaten when pulled up before the second last
Settled last - asked to improve three furlongs out and driven again approaching two furlongs out - up to second in the final furlong - hit the front inside the final 110 yards and stayed on
Settled in third - up to second with two furlongs left - driven to the front with a furlong out - overtaken inside the final 110 yards by the winner
In front early - driven and overtaken with a furlong left - faded inside the final 110 yards
Sat close up behind the front-runner - dropped from second and driven with two furlongs left - not knocked about with a furlong to go

settled towards the back but not far off the pace - driven soon after halfway - improved into contention from 2f out - wandered under pressure inside the final furlong - mildly bumped when hitting the front inside the final 110 yards but stayed on

dashed to the front and dictated an even gallop before opening a three length advantage soon after halfway - driven 2f out - advantage narrowed with a furlong left - drifted right when overtaken inside the final 110 yards and found nothing more towards the finish
settled towards the back - driven 3f out - drifted right gaining third 2f out - no match for the front two inside the final furlong and faded towards the finish
third early - found short of speed 4f out and soon toiling - a shade of progress entering the final furlong - stayed on at one speed towards the finish
second early - driven 3f out - driven again when slipping back over 2f out - faded fast inside the final furlong and a little adrift towards the finish

Raced in touch with the front runners - up to second before 3 out - driven to the front before 2 out - asked for another effort before the last where clear by 2 lengths - responded up the run-in and was pressed close to home but stayed in front to prevail

Went straight to the front from the break - given encouragement after 4 out - driven before 3 out - lost the advantage before 2 out - soon driven again and continued in second - 2 lengths adrift at the last - battled back up the run-in to challenge the front-runner late on - narrowly beaten into second close to the line
Travelled in the pack on the wide side before improving into third and being driven before 2 out - asked for more but made no real impact before the last to finish third
Raced close to the front runners - dropped away before 3 out and was soon detached in rear to finish fourth
Held up at the back of the field and hesitant at the fourth last where given encouragement - looked short of zest in the rhythm all the way to finish fifth
Racing prominently early - dropped away in a hurry before 2 out and was pulled up
Racing in the pack - driven into third with a furlong left - kept on well and hit the front near the finish
Up with the pace - driven to the front with a furlong left - continued well but overtaken near the finish
Settled just off the pace - driven with two furlongs left - up to third inside the final 110 yards and continued well
Sat close up behind the pace - driven with two furlongs left - battled on in the final furlong
Set the pace early - driven and overtaken with a furlong left - dropped away inside the final 110 yards
Racing in the pack - urged to quicken with two furlongs left - soon dropped away
Settled last - driven with two furlongs left - moved ahead of tired others with a furlong left but always adrift
Settled just off the pace - driven with two furlongs left - always adrift without threatening
travelled in a forward position - driven 2f out - closed on the pack with a furlong left before going to the front inside it - stayed on strongly
settled towards the back - driven to improve position from 1f out and up into second inside the final 110 yards - couldn't get to the winner in the closing strides
raced close to the pace - went to the front with a furlong left - drifted left when overtaken inside the final 110 yards - faded into third in the closing strides
settled towards the back - shifted towards the middle to improve position with a furlong left - unable to quicken inside the final furlong and faded towards the finish
travelled in a forward position - closed on the pacesetter 2f out - shaded for pace inside the final furlong and faded towards the finish
went to the front - driven when overtaken before halfway - soon short of speed and faded fast over 1f out - not knocked about when well adrift inside the final 110 yards
Raced close to the front runners - went to the front 4 out under a drive - driven clear before the last despite a spread there and stayed on strongly up the run-in to win

Racing close to the pace early - clipped the thirteenth - erred at the following fence and needed urging - continued under pressure after the second last - up to second at the last fence but couldn't threaten the winner
Set the pace from the start - hesitant at the fifth - lost the advantage 4 out and was driven - kept competing in touch before emptying out approaching the last to finish third
Held up towards the back of the field - driven at the thirteenth without effect before dropping away before 4 out to finish fourth
Led from the start - driven further ahead with a furlong left - won with something in hand
Sat behind the front-runner - driven with a furlong left - ran on without threatening the winner
Settled in third - urged to quicken with two furlongs left - dropped away with a furlong to go - not knocked about at the finish
Began untidily - showed temperament early and was strung out alone at the back - always a non-factor
